RESONANT ARCANA — 1.1.3

God magic should sound as powerful as it looks.

Minecraft 1.21.1 · NeoForge · Java 21

Casting that lasts

  • Charge poses now remain active until the spell actually releases or is cancelled, including long God casts and changes to casting speed.
  • Eventide Horizon gathers a compact orbiting focus with a steady two-handed pose.

A stronger soundtrack

  • Rebuilt God spell audio using native Iron’s Spells and boss recordings, with sustained charge and ritual cues.
  • Timed impact sounds play even when a spell lands on empty ground.
  • The sun, moon, eclipse and Helvar’s sword now have distinct, layered impacts synchronized with contact.
  • Impact audio reaches the caster at range while respecting the existing sound settings. Sound cues are spaced to the recordings’ lengths.

Clearer forms

  • Tremorzilla Cataclysm fires its purple beam from your hands. The giant head is removed.
  • Dragon’s Primordial Inferno keeps its aimed fire blast and fire resistance; wings and temporary flight are removed.
  • Primordial Sovereign raises a basalt volcano with magma streams, native tephra arcs and fiery eruptions inspired by Luxtructosaurus. Damage, allied buffs and terrain protection are preserved.

Includes the non-lightning particle and launch-height fixes from 1.1.2. Update both client and server to 1.1.3.
